subject.title: feat: add safe hybrid local archive collection

question: Should Discrawl core support a native hybrid archive mode that combines canonical Git snapshots with locally retained private/archive rows and cross-path message exclusions?
rationale: This is a new user-facing persistence and operational model rather than a repair to an established contract; choosing its supported guarantees, upgrade expectations, and core scope requires maintainer intent.

options.title: Sponsor a defined core contract
options.body: Approve hybrid collection as a core workflow after recording the guarantees for safe merge, exclusions, local-row preservation, and forced replacement.

options.title: Narrow the feature
options.body: Request a smaller first slice, such as documented safe snapshot preservation or collection exclusions, before accepting the full hybrid operational model.

options.title: Defer core adoption
options.body: Keep the PR open while maintainers decide whether this workflow should remain an external/operator pattern rather than a supported core mode.

recommendation.title: Sponsor a defined core contract
recommendation.body: Approve hybrid collection as a core workflow after recording the guarantees for safe merge, exclusions, local-row preservation, and forced replacement.

likelyOwner.reason: They authored the integrated feature series and are the clearest available routing candidate for clarifying the intended contract with repository decision-makers.
